$schema: Act II radio news bulletins (S7 data). Broadcast from the Varli Prasarayan Tower 'Mother Tower' and the Koliwada community mast. Played at chapter transitions 6-10; each bulletin is a queue of VO line objects consumable by the ./vo/ system (line.lineId + line.textOriginal).

bulletins.headline: Harbour freight logs show drums moved inland overnight

lines.textOriginal: Traffic update. Harbour depot logs show drums moved inland overnight. Vanijya Sankeerna, not the jetty.
lines.textTranslation: Traffic update. Harbour depot logs show drums moved inland overnight. Vanijya Sankeerna, not the jetty.

lines.textOriginal: Police ask drivers to avoid the creek road after eleven. They do not say why.
lines.textTranslation: Police ask drivers to avoid the creek road after eleven. They do not say why.

bulletins.tone: community radio, close to the mic, sea sounds behind
bulletins.headline: The Mother Tower hums at night

lines.textOriginal: Sun listeners — Varli tower has a new frequency again. It hums between songs. Nobody claims it.
lines.textTranslation: Dear listeners — the Varli tower has a new frequency again. It hums between songs. Nobody claims it.

lines.textOriginal: Mera signal ajeeb hai. Aapka bhi? Phone kijiye.
lines.textTranslation: My signal is strange. Yours too? Call us.

bulletins.headline: Local train skips Platform Six again

lines.textOriginal: The 18:42 local skipped Platform Six again. Crew cite a signal fault.
lines.textTranslation: The 18:42 local skipped Platform Six again. Crew cite a signal fault.

lines.textOriginal: Passengers say a man in a grey coat walked the length of the platform and got off at no station.
lines.textTranslation: Passengers say a man in a grey coat walked the length of the platform and got off at no station.

lines.textOriginal: Markets watch the harbour. The Vanijya night ledger has gaps. The harbour office calls it paperwork.
lines.textTranslation: Markets watch the harbour. The Vanijya night ledger has gaps. The harbour office calls it paperwork.

lines.textOriginal: Paperwork you cannot read is not paperwork. It is a lock.
lines.textTranslation: Paperwork you cannot read is not paperwork. It is a lock.

lines.textOriginal: Lower Parel mill plots change hands in threes. The registry stamp is the same hand.
lines.textTranslation: Lower Parel mill plots change hands in threes. The registry stamp is the same hand.

lines.textOriginal: Three sales, one stamp, zero signatures. The market calls it efficiency. We call it a pattern.
lines.textTranslation: Three sales, one stamp, zero signatures. The market calls it efficiency. We call it a pattern.

bulletins.tone: community radio, close to the mic, sea sounds behind
bulletins.headline: Community mast hears the harbour at night

lines.textOriginal: Listeners near the Koliwada mast report harbour noise on the frequency. Harbour is ten kilometres away.
lines.textTranslation: Listeners near the Koliwada mast report harbour noise on the frequency. The harbour is ten kilometres away.

lines.textOriginal: Yaar, paani ka awaaz hai. Bees kilo meter door. Kaise?
lines.textTranslation: Friend, it is the sound of water. Ten kilometres away. How?

bulletins.headline: Fire at a Fort print shop

lines.textOriginal: Breaking: a print shop near the xerox row burned overnight. Owners say the presses were already gone.
lines.textTranslation: Breaking: a print shop near the xerox row burned overnight. Owners say the presses were already gone.

lines.textOriginal: Fire crews took forty minutes. The water pressure was low. Again.
lines.textTranslation: Fire crews took forty minutes. The water pressure was low. Again.

bulletins.tone: late-night, low voice, first broadcast of the new station
bulletins.headline: One copy left

lines.textOriginal: If you are hearing this, the last copy is still out there. Do not let them print over it.
lines.textTranslation: If you are hearing this, the last copy is still out there. Do not let them print over it.

lines.textOriginal: Aaj raat, hum bol rahe hain. Kal shayad nahi.
lines.textTranslation: Tonight we speak. Tomorrow, maybe not.

bulletins.headline: Case numbers vanish from the registry

lines.textOriginal: Three case files carry no number. The registry clerk asks for patience; the police ask for silence.
lines.textTranslation: Three case files carry no number. The registry clerk asks for patience; the police ask for silence.

lines.textOriginal: A file with no number is not a file. It is a hole.
lines.textTranslation: A file with no number is not a file. It is a hole.

bulletins.headline: The pirate frequency is the story now

lines.textOriginal: Every station carries it now: an unlicensed voice reading the harbour ledger aloud. The Mother Tower does not stop it.
lines.textTranslation: Every station carries it now: an unlicensed voice reading the harbour ledger aloud. The Mother Tower does not stop it.

lines.textOriginal: Wo tower jo sabko rokti hai, ab humein nahi rok sakti.
lines.textTranslation: The tower that stops everyone can no longer stop us.
